annotations.title: My Video Channel — Free Video Hosting

description: Upload your videos once, then share your whole channel or just one video with a link. No ads, no algorithm. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

about.description: rename only: a line about the channel shown under its name, up to 500 characters.

action.description: add (default) puts an uploaded video on the caller's channel and returns its link and the channel's link; the channel is created on the first add. list returns the channel and every video on it with tokens. edit changes one video by token (title, description, listed). remove deletes one video and its file. rename changes the channel's name and about text.

description.description: Text shown under the video, up to 2000 characters. Plain text.

durationMs.description: add only: the length in milliseconds, if known.

fileId.description: add only: the id of a video file the caller already owns. Upload it first with POST /v1/files/upload-url, a PUT of the bytes, then POST /v1/files/confirm. An H.264 MP4 plays in every browser; other formats may not play on every device.

height.description: add only: the height in pixels, if known.

listed.description: true (default) shows the video on the channel page. false makes it link only (unlisted): reachable by its own link and not shown on the channel.

locale.description: add only: the language the channel's pages are written in (en, de, es, fr, it, nl, pl, pt, fi). Default en.

name.description: add and rename: the channel's name, up to 60 characters. On add it is used only when the channel is created.

posterFileId.description: add only: optional id of an uploaded image (JPEG or PNG) shown before the video plays.

title.description: The video's title, up to 100 characters. Required for add.

token.description: edit and remove: the video's token, from list or from add's answer.

width.description: add only: the width in pixels, if known.
